datasets.name: events_timeline
datasets.description: Structural event timeline aligned to nalex_viz_projection_contract.json — no raw text
datasets.schema_note: Fields: record_id, timestamp, event_type, speaker_role, phase, loop_type, sequence, move_codes, direct_response_status, repair_response_status, source_review_state, projection_eligibility, privacy_level

datasets.name: theme_metrics
datasets.description: Per-phase/per-speaker message and word counts with extracted themes
datasets.schema_note: Fields: phase, speaker, message_count, word_count, theme_count, extracted_themes

datasets.name: phase_profiles
datasets.description: Relationship phase metrics — event counts, session counts, per-speaker breakdowns
datasets.schema_note: Fields: phase_name, window, calendar_days, event_count, naomi_*/alex_* speaker metrics, asymmetry ratios, flags

datasets.name: gap_analysis
datasets.description: Inter-event silence gaps sorted by duration
datasets.schema_note: Fields: gap_id (local_id), event_id, prev_event_id, timestamp, prev_timestamp, gap_seconds, gap_minutes, sha256

datasets.name: orphan_events
datasets.description: Events without confirmed incident assignment — proposed classifications and review status
datasets.schema_note: Fields: orphan_id, timestamp, session_id, original_assignment, proposed_classification, proposed_parent, confidence, evidence_basis, boundary_or_exclusion_reason, review_status

privacy_note: events_timeline.csv contains NO raw transcript text. All txt/txt_v3/txt_raw_prior fields stripped at export.

column_conventions.timestamp: ISO 8601 or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS from source
